svg.text: Nightlight Rev K - routed PCB draft
52 x 52 mm | 2 layers | Front-mounted modules | Bottom LEDs
Measured module outlines; USB shell legs use broad solder lands; D+/D- tails trimmed.
Red: top copper. Blue: bottom copper. Faint features: opposite side. Shaded regions: RF exclusions.
See validation.json for checks. Native JLCEDA DRC and fabrication export are required.
